tool_schemas.name: API-simple-price
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached simple price and optional market fields for the requested coin IDs (and vs-currencies) as a map keyed by coin id (and, when applicable, contract address), including fields such as `usd`, `usd_market_cap`, `usd_24h_vol`, `usd_24h_change`, and `last_updated_at`; this endpoint does not paginate because results are bounded to the IDs you request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required query parameters are missing, empty, or malformed (for example invalid id/currency lists or unsupported quote currencies), and NOT_FOUND when none of the provided IDs exist in our cache. Raises RATE_LIMITED when your client exceeds the configured request quota.

tool_schemas.name: API-admin-coins-upsert
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new cached coin or updates an existing coin record by `coingecko_id`, including lifecycle status changes allowed by the schema. Refuses invalid lifecycle transitions, duplicate primary keys, or attempts to set `status` to a value not in the enum.

api_key.description: Server API key with write scope.

coin.description: Coin fields to create or update; unspecified fields are left unchanged on update.

id.description: Internal coin primary key; omit to let the server generate one.

platforms.description: Map of platform id to contract address.

status.description: Lifecycle status; transitions are restricted by the server.

tool_schemas.name: API-auth-whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity derived from the presented credential, including granted scopes and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses missing or invalid credentials.

metadata.name: CoinGecko API Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a CoinGecko-like read API by maintaining a local cache of coins, their market snapshots, and derived time-series (OHLC). It also tracks search queries and trending aggregates to serve fast search endpoints while refreshing data from upstream sources on a schedule. Repository: htt
